The cheapest plan costs **212**: 192 minutes of driving plus a 20 penalty for deferring one adult from Gosaikunda.

**Car 1 (starts at Kalika shelter)** brings all 4 people at Kakani village (3 injured, 1 child) back to Kalika shelter. That is 28 minutes.

**Car 2 (starts at Dhunche hospital)** makes four round trips, 164 minutes in total:
1. To Jwalamukhi school for 3 injured and 1 child, then back to the hospital (18 minutes).
2. To Naukunda market by way of Jwalamukhi school for the 3 adults. On the way back it picks up the last child at Jwalamukhi, then returns to the hospital (54 minutes). This costs 36 minutes more than collecting the child alone, which is less than the 60 penalty for deferring the three adults.
3. To Gosaikunda village for the 4 injured, then back to the hospital (46 minutes).
4. To Gosaikunda again for 3 children and 1 adult, then back to the hospital (46 minutes).

**Deferred:** one adult at Gosaikunda. A third round trip there would take 46 minutes, which costs more than the penalty of 20.
